<\STATESEP>chapter "Fault Handlers"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>theory ArchFaultHandler_H
imports TCB_H Structures_H
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>context Arch begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>global_naming ARM_H<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>consts'
makeArchFaultMessage :: "arch_fault \<Rightarrow> machine_word \<Rightarrow> (machine_word * machine_word list) kernel"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>consts'
handleArchFaultReply :: "arch_fault \<Rightarrow> machine_word \<Rightarrow> machine_word \<Rightarrow> machine_word list \<Rightarrow> bool kernel"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs makeArchFaultMessage_def:
"makeArchFaultMessage x0 thread\<equiv> (case x0 of
    (VMFault vptr archData) \<Rightarrow>    (do
    pc \<leftarrow> asUser thread getRestartPC;
    return (5, pc#fromVPtr vptr#archData)
    od)
  )"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs handleArchFaultReply_def:
"handleArchFaultReply x0 x1 x2 x3\<equiv> (case x0 of
    (VMFault _ _) \<Rightarrow>    return True
  )"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
